Calcitic lime (CaCO₃), dolomitic lime (supplies Mg), quicklime (CaO), slaked lime (Ca(OH)₂). Gypsum does not raise pH.
Lime corrects pH (t/ha, every few years); fertiliser supplies nutrients (kg/ha, every season).

front: How many times more acid is pH 5 than pH 6?
back: 10 times: the pH scale is logarithmic.
